sections.content: Building for the world means: lang attributes, UTF-8 charset always, RTL-aware layouts (dir="rtl"), locale-aware dates/numbers, and text expansion room (German is ~30% longer than English).
Avoid hardcoded strings concatenated in markup — separate them for translation. Bidirectional text (Arabic/Hebrew mixed with numbers) needs dir attributes on elements.
Key points: <html lang> drives pronunciation for screen readers, charset must be first in <head>, and test with pseudo-localization.
Try this variation — change a value, predict the output, then run it:
sections.codeExample:
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head><meta charset="UTF-8"></head>
<!-- --> experiment: modify a value above and predict the new output
